linux: for tool in git java node corepack npm cargo uv; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Missing required tool: $tool" >&2; exit 1; }; done
case "$(java -version 2>&1 | head -n 1)" in *\"25.*) ;; *) echo "Java 25 is required by the Bosca composite build" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac

sdk_dir="${ANDROID_HOME:-${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}}"; test -d "$sdk_dir" || { echo "Android SDK not found; set ANDROID_HOME or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" >&2; exit 1; }; for project in . services-di bosca-yks bosca-kmp apps/client-core-ui; do printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$sdk_dir" > "$project/local.properties"; done
